title: Research: exclude the P112 eight-vertex support-union profile
body:
## Summary

Exclude the actual eleven-piece P112 TWOSIDE `(7,4)` profile `4,5^2,6^8` over every characteristic-zero field, under the stated independence and code-intersection hypotheses.

```text
Eight-vertex mixed branch:          162 > 160 endpoint incidences
All-root arbitrary-cut relaxation:  158 <= 160, insufficient
Actual 4/5/5-flat support union:     162 > 160 in every frame orbit
```

Only `research/p112-eight-vertex-union/` is added. It contains the proof, exact finite receipt, pinned sources, behavioral controls and reproduction instructions. This removes one profile from the original 154 survivors; full C5, the decoder floor, suppliers and kappa remain unresolved. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and the retained E8/P112 lineage; Nick Petalas/PR3164/3175/3176 for root geometry, support spectra and the support-72 alphabet. A [concurrent same-profile claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19000159) uses a different relaxation of the rank-four support. This package supplies a separate actual-support union proof and replay, without exclusive priority claims.

## Evidence

- Before: arbitrary forty-coordinate deletion gives 158 in one A7 branch; separate flat maxima leave 156,160,160 in three frame orbits.
- After: all 9,737 mixed six-cliques, 2,025 orthogonal frames, 6,619,494 binary four-/five-flats and complete filtered support unions give the strict bound. The discarded-case caps are included; filtered maxima are not described as global union optima.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and fourteen optimized behavioral groups pass. Separate Gram/intersection, integer-rank, 3+3 clique and set-union calculations agree. Source/receipt mutants, a planted failing union and a one-extra-cut witness are included.
- Optimized Python 3.13 replay and controls pass in a read-only Git-free export. The exact committed export also passes the verifier. Ruff diagnostics and formatting pass.
- All twenty publication files/inputs byte-match commit `27c4c1d4a9f752fe732e0a82bcadac89f770056a`.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-eight-vertex-union
```

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19000168). `CHECKS.json` records commands and limits. Evidence is author-checked. Internal read-only reviews are not independent human or proof-kernel verification; the standard Weyl-chamber theorem and original reduction remain explicit dependencies. Main baseline is `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6. Development and local checks used substantial automated assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Isolated opt-in package. Shared verifiers, supplier inputs, selected records and frozen predecessors are unchanged.
